title: Stanley-Reisner Theory in Mixed Characteristic
summary: We discuss a class of mixed characteristic rings defined analogously to Stanley-Reisner rings by replacing one variable with a uniformizing parameter for a discrete valuation ring. We adapt Hochster's formula for Tor and Ext modules, Hochster's formula for local cohomology, and Terai's criterion for Serre conditions to this new setting; one of the tools needed is cellular sheaf cohomology, for which we give a brief treatment.
